wait.finding: Reviewed server/websockets/hub.go and client.go at the tagged commit: a hub sends Type/Data notifications to registered websocket clients; Broadcast returns without sending when no client is counted and otherwise hands the message to the hub from a new goroutine, so the order of separate broadcasts is not fixed; each client queues 256 prepared messages and a client whose queue is full is dropped; the upgrade response is written before the hub registers the client, and nothing acknowledges registration; writes have a 10 s deadline and pings run every 54 s. These bodies do not show which route serves the hub, which producer broadcasts new mail or when relative to storage, or any replay after a gap. A dropped notification is not a lost stored message, and no lossless subscribe-before-scan wait is established.
